releases.notes: ECU link rework (Ignitron-matched session start, validated polling, adaptation maps). FTDI cables such as VCDS interfaces now work through the bridge (idle status replies answered on the bridge, a cancelled request on a finished transfer is answered). New boards default to WiFi channel 1 (same as can2gauge and OpenHaldex; boards already set up keep theirs). Phone touch UI: no long-press copy menu, scrolling never moves a slider.

First full release (rebranded usb2ip): USB-A port on demand - boots in standby (5V off, mux open) until USB-C or a WiFi client asks; TPS2041B over-current fault read. Pre-1.0 parameter exports still import.
OTA overhaul: update from GitHub, Home WiFi bridge mode, recovery page; shared ota_manager/wifi_manager v2.
